name: Pink shimmer
desc: A shimmering haze: a pink-noise bed drifting under opposite-phase filter and pan sweeps, sprinkled with high sine sparkles that twinkle and degrade like light on water. Full and peak thicken the sparkle and add a white-noise glint. An airy top-end wash for dreampop.

code.full: stack(s("pink").attack(.3).decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.5).hpf(500).lpf(sine.range(3000,${cut}).slow(20)).gain(${gain}*.8).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(20)), note("c6 g6 e7 b6 g7 e7 c7 g6").s("sine").decay(.18).sustain(0).degradeBy(.2).hpf(1500).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(20)).gain(${spark}).room(.5)).lpf(${cut}).room(.5).size(.92).orbit(7).play()
code.peak: stack(s("pink").attack(.2).decay(.25).sustain(.45).release(.4).hpf(500).lpf(sine.range(4000,${cut}).slow(16)).gain(${gain}*.85).pan(sine.range(.25,.75).slow(16)), note("c6 g6 e7 b6 g7 e7 d7 b6 g7 e7 c7 g6 e7 b6 g7 c8").s("sine").decay(.14).sustain(0).degradeBy(.15).hpf(2000).pan(cosine.range(.25,.75).slow(16)).gain(${spark}).room(.55), s("white*4").decay(.05).sustain(0).hpf(9000).gain(${gain}*.5)).lpf(${cut}).room(.5).size(.95).orbit(7).play()
